scope: Implement reviewed buyer guidance, new official facts and an EN/ES printable worksheet; evaluate photo rights for a fixed four-store cohort.
photo_review_limits: Known official home/about/gallery pages and targeted Commons queries only. No merchant outreach, Google image extraction or expansion to 191 stores. Missing results do not establish missing images or closure.

design.type: Reuse the existing system sans-serif; readable body copy and short section headings.
design.layout: Left-aligned purchase preparation sheet with a narrow reading column, source-backed store links and ruled fields for handwritten quotes. Mobile flows in one column; print isolates the worksheet.
design.wireframe: Title / purpose -> four merchant links -> neutral purchase questions -> printable ruled worksheet -> official resources
design.review: Retain the established site identity. Avoid a new comparison dashboard, decorative metrics or a photo placeholder gallery. Distinctive element is a practical purchasing sheet with room for actual quotes.
